t: You're looking at St Sepulchre-without-Newgate, also called Holy Sepulchre, the largest Anglican parish church in the City of London. Some remarkable people are buried here. John Smith, the soldier and explorer, helped establish the Jamestown colony in Virginia and was the first English explorer to map the Chesapeake Bay area. Roger Ascham was a scholar who tutored Elizabeth in Greek and Latin before she became queen. And Sir Henry Wood, the conductor, is buried here. He led the Proms for nearly half a century, and the concerts were renamed in his honour after his death.
